kind: analysis choices, assumptions and learner-task inputs; nothing in this file is measured in the Demerzel repository

series_rule.note: Analysis choice. A series is one artifact under one instrument: it starts at the artifact's first row that carries a citation_count and restarts at each row flagged rebaseline: true. Seed rows (baseline: true) carry no count and belong to no series.

rolling_origin.note: Analysis choice. Every row of a series that has at least min_training_rows rows before it is a target in turn; the forecast uses only the rows before it. Two rows is the least the drift forecast needs, and the same origins are used for the three methods.

run_gap_bounds_days.note: Analysis choice, not an observation: the gap between an origin run and its target run counts as 'about a day' when it lies inside these bounds.

time_split.note: Analysis choice. The test rows are the last quarter of each series (rounded down, at least one row); the training rows are all the rows before them. cut_sweep in results.json repeats the comparison for every other cut.

random_split_cross_check.note: Seeded draws that check the exact average over all random splits through a second code path. A split takes the test rows with the smallest random.Random(seed).random() keys.

extrapolation.assumption: Runs in which at least one count changes keep occurring at the frequency observed between rebaselined runs. One observed change run does not support this assumption; it only sets a scale.

transfer_task.note: Hypothetical weekly counts of pages that link to three documents of a wiki. Not Streeling data and not a forecast.
